name: core.openwop.connections.hubspot
description: HubSpot connection pack (RFC 0095) — OAuth2 (authorization-code) provider for the HubSpot CRM v3 REST API (contacts, companies, deals, tickets). ADR 0033 DEPLOY-GATED. Reach is `openapi` against HubSpot's documented REST surface (api.hubapi.com): HubSpot ships no first-party hosted MCP server, so the documented API is the honest day-1 reach (ADR 0033 §4). HubSpot was the top CRM absence vs the market-standard app surface in the ADR 0190 template research. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the app client id/secret host-side (ADR 0024 §7).
